subject: English
question_text: Suppose you are Nasima of 50, Sylhet-3100. You have a
stimulus: best friend who named Salma was lived at 30 Alam Plaza, Sylhet Sadar. She is a chain smoker. Now, write a letter to your friend advising her to give up smoking. 10
guide_solution: Letter writing Sherpur 12, November 2015 My dear Salma, I am in receipt of your sweet note. But I am sorry to know that you have become a chain-smoker. Don't you think how shocking it would be to your parents? I am sure that you are aware of the dangers of smoking. Then why are you affecting yourself? How terrific it is! A single puff of cigarette smoke contains 15 billion injurious particles . Dear friend, this smoke simply ruins you by its nicotine, methyl, alcohol, carbon monoxide, formaldehyed, arsenic, benzopyrene and several other acids. So, I earnestly request you to give up this habit. Please do not ruin yourself. It’s high time, you gave up smoking. As a conscious citizen, you should give up this bad habit as early as possible. I am very hopeful about your right decision. No more today. Hope to see you hale and hearty soon. Yours ever Nasima
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 87 — Matripith Govt. Girls' High School, Chandpur

subject: English
question_text: Mobile phone is one of the wonders of modern science. It
stimulus: had added a new dimension to our way of life and to the communication system. But it can be misused by someone. Now, write a dialogue between you and your friend Roza on the merits and demerits of using mobile phone. 10
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue on the merits and demerits of mobile phone. See Pabna Cadet College. Sl. No. 04; Page No. 48 (a) Honey is naturally produced by bees through the collection of nectar from different flowers and then stores them in the hive. The bee-keepers rear bees in wooden hives and produce honey commercially. (b) Bee keeping helps in generation of employment as many NGOs trained many bee-keeper about it and they are engaged in producing honey commercially and lead their life happily. (c) NGO's are providing accessories like bee-box, knife, bees, queen gate, honey extractor on credit. (d) The advantages of bee keeping are that all the accessories that are needed to produce honey have got free of cost from many NGOs. After completing training bee keepers earn money and lead a peaceful life by producing honey by bees. They get credit from the govt. and NGO to develop their production of honey. (e) The contribution of Bangladesh Small and Cottage Industries Corporation to bee-keeping is that it reduces poverty and helps to employ many generations.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 87 — Matripith Govt. Girls' High School, Chandpur
